I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-i5rhyb38/requests/utils.py#L960-L988).

### Root Cause
In [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-i5rhyb38/requests/utils.py#L960-L988), `urllib3.util.parse_url` is used to parse the proxy URL, and `parsed.netloc` is used to reconstruct the URL via `urlunparse`. However, `urllib3.util.Url.netloc` only includes the `host` and `port` components—it omits `auth`. Consequently, proxy authentication credentials in the proxy URL were stripped before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-i5rhyb38/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted them, resulting in a missing `Proxy-Authorization` header and `407 Proxy Authentication Required` responses.

### Solution
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-i5rhyb38/requests/utils.py#L977-L980) to prepend `auth` to `netloc` (`'@'.join([auth, netloc])`) when `auth` is present in the parsed URL.
